Yes.
Entry by entry,
$c_1 \vecf{v}_1 + c_2 \vecf{v}_2 = \tp{(c_1,\ c_1 + c_2,\ c_2)}$.
Matching $\vecf{w}$,
the first entry gives $c_1 = 3$
and the third gives $c_2 = 2$.
Then the second entry is $3 + 2 = 5$,
which matches too,
so $\vecf{w} = 3 \vecf{v}_1 + 2 \vecf{v}_2$
is in the [span](#def-span).

:::
